ArtifactDescriptions.verification.backend: Shared verification storage and signing resources consumed by the isolated test host.
ArtifactDescriptions.verification.backend-transactions: Persists verification transactions and their outcomes for replay protection and audit review.
ArtifactDescriptions.verification.backend-signing: Signs verification results with an asymmetric KMS key so the host can trust each outcome.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app: Isolated demo host that starts, confirms, and inspects email verification transactions.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-records: Stores test host requests and their state while the demo verification flow runs.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-hmac: Generates the key used to hash verification codes without storing plaintext codes.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-encryption: Generates the key used to protect verification proofs while they await delivery.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-secrets: Keeps the test host HMAC and encryption keys in AWS Secrets Manager.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-secret-values: Stores the generated HMAC and encryption key values in the protected secret.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-sender: Registers the From address used to send verification codes through Amazon SES.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-role: Gives the test host Lambda a dedicated execution identity.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-logs: Collects test host Lambda logs with a seven-day retention period.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-permissions: Limits the Lambda to its tables, signing key, secret, logs, and the selected SES sender and recipient.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost-app-lambda: Runs the demo API and scheduled verification worker in one test host Lambda.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-worker: Runs the periodic scan that sends mail, signs outcomes, delivers results, and clears expired proofs.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost-app-worker-permission: Allows the scheduled EventBridge rule to invoke the test host Lambda.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-worker-target: Connects the periodic EventBridge rule to the test host Lambda with a tick event.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-users: Holds isolated demo users for mobile API authentication.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-android: Provides a public Cognito app client for the Android demo.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-api: Exposes the email verification demo endpoints through an HTTP API.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-stage: Publishes the HTTP API default stage with request throttling.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-auth: Checks Cognito JWTs before allowing calls to the demo API.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-invoke: Forwards approved HTTP API requests to the test host Lambda.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-start: Routes requests to begin an email verification transaction.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-confirm: Routes requests that confirm a verification link or code.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-status: Routes requests that check a verification transaction's status.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost-app-demo-permission-start: Allows the start route to invoke the test host Lambda.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost-app-demo-permission-confirm: Allows the confirm route to invoke the test host Lambda.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost-app-demo-permission-status: Allows the status route to invoke the test host Lambda.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-certificate: Requests a TLS certificate for the environment-specific mobile API hostname.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-certificate-dns: Publishes the DNS challenge used to validate the mobile API certificate.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-domain-validated: Waits for DNS validation before the mobile API certificate is used.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-domain: Assigns the environment-specific HTTPS hostname to API Gateway.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-mapping: Maps the mobile hostname to the demo API's default stage.
ArtifactDescriptions.testhost.app-demo-hostname: Points the public mobile API hostname to its API Gateway endpoint.

Inputs.Name: Domain
Inputs.Label: Ownership domain
Inputs.Help: Enter the base domain, such as apexfission.com. The wizard adds the environment and service labels.

Inputs.Name: Sender
Inputs.Label: SES From address
Inputs.Help: Use the suggested address, enter a local part, or enter a full address whose inbox you can access for SES verification.

Inputs.Name: Recipient
Inputs.Label: Test recipient
Inputs.Help: Enter the full address that receives the code. In the SES sandbox, verify this address in the deployment region.

Inputs.Name: DNSProvider
Inputs.Label: Public DNS provider
Inputs.Help: Choose the provider serving the sender domain. The mobile API uses this provider by default.
